Chair: Captain Vance, the board has received complaints that the ferry ran forty minutes late on three days in March. Explain yourself.
Vance: Fog. Three days of fog. I will not run blind with forty people aboard.
Chair: Other operators ran on schedule.
Vance: Other operators got lucky. Plain as rope: lucky is not a safety plan.
Board Member: Are you saying the board's schedule is unsafe?
Vance: I'm saying the schedule doesn't know about fog. The water does. I listen to the water.
Chair: That is not an answer, Captain.
Vance: It's the only answer I have. Here's the thing. You want on time, buy a bridge. You want alive, keep me.
Board Member: Would you accept a new vessel with radar upgrades?
Vance: We fix the boat we have. Put the radar on the old one. She's tired, not dead.
